title: New Apple CEO John Ternus Looks Toward a Big Future
subtitle: After taking over from Tim Cook, the new leader prepares for his first major product event.

summary.en: John Ternus has officially started his role as the new CEO of Apple. In his first message to employees, he thanked former leader Tim Cook for his years of service. Ternus is now preparing for a major product launch event scheduled for September 9. The company is expected to show off new iPhone models, including potential foldable versions. Looking ahead, Ternus plans to focus on creating new and innovative technology for the future.
summary.zh: 強恩·特納斯已正式接任蘋果執行長一職。他在給員工的第一封訊息中，感謝前任領導者提姆·庫克多年的貢獻。特納斯目前正為預計於九月九日舉行的大型產品發表會做準備。外界預期該公司將展示新款 iPhone，包含潛在的折疊式版本。展望未來，特納斯計畫專注於為未來創造創新科技。

paragraphs.en: John Ternus has officially begun his journey as the new CEO of Apple. Following the recent leadership change, Ternus sent his first message to the company’s staff. In this note, he expressed his gratitude to his predecessor, Tim Cook, for his guidance and his many years of hard work. According to The Verge, Ternus praised Cook for leading the company with strong values and kindness, noting that the entire team has benefited from his leadership. Cook will continue to support the company as its executive chairman.
paragraphs.zh: 強恩·特納斯 (John Ternus) 已正式開啟他擔任蘋果 (Apple) 新任執行長的旅程。在近期領導層更迭後，特納斯向全體員工發出了他的第一封訊息。在信中，他對前任執行長提姆·庫克 (Tim Cook) 的指導與多年來的辛勤付出表達了感謝。根據科技媒體 The Verge 報導，特納斯讚揚庫克以堅定的價值觀與仁慈領導公司，並指出整個團隊都受益於他的領導。庫克將繼續以執行董事長的身分支持公司。

paragraphs.en: While the change in leadership is a major moment for the technology giant, Ternus is moving quickly to focus on the future. His first big test as CEO is only a few days away. As reported by The Verge, citing information from Bloomberg, Apple is preparing for a major product event on September 9. Ternus described this upcoming launch as "phenomenal" and thanked the staff for their hard work in making it possible.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管領導層的變動對這家科技巨頭而言是重大時刻，但特納斯正迅速採取行動，將重心放在未來。他擔任執行長後面臨的第一個重大考驗即將在幾天後到來。根據 The Verge 引述彭博社 (Bloomberg) 的資訊報導，蘋果正為九月九日的一場大型產品發表會做準備。特納斯形容這場即將到來的發表會「非比尋常」，並感謝員工為此付出的辛勞。

paragraphs.en: Industry experts and fans are waiting to see what new devices will be revealed at the September event. Based on recent reports, the company is expected to show off new iPhone models. There is significant interest in rumors about a new "iPhone Ultra" and the latest "iPhone 18 Pro" models. Some reports suggest that the company might even introduce a foldable iPhone, a design that would be a significant change for the brand. These products are seen as a key part of Apple's strategy to stay ahead in a very competitive market.
paragraphs.zh: 產業專家與粉絲們都在等待九月的發表會將揭曉哪些新裝置。根據近期報導，外界預期該公司將展示新款 iPhone。關於「iPhone Ultra」與最新「iPhone 18 Pro」機型的傳聞引起了高度關注。部分報導甚至暗示，該公司可能會推出折疊式 iPhone，這項設計對該品牌而言將是一項重大變革。這些產品被視為蘋果在競爭激烈的市場中保持領先地位的關鍵策略。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the September event, Ternus is already thinking about what comes next. In his message to the team, he spoke about "incredible products already in the works." He also mentioned that the company plans to create things that people have not even imagined yet. While he did not give specific details, he hinted at a future that moves beyond the products we know today. This could include new types of hardware, such as home robots or advanced display technology, which have been topics of discussion in the tech world for some time.
paragraphs.zh: 除了九月的發表會，特納斯已經在思考下一步。他在給團隊的訊息中提到「已有令人驚豔的產品正在研發中」。他也提到公司計畫創造出人們尚未想像到的事物。雖然他未透露具體細節，但他暗示了未來將超越我們今日所知的產品。這可能包含新型硬體，例如家用機器人或先進的顯示技術，這些在科技界已是討論多時的話題。

paragraphs.en: This leadership change comes at a challenging time for Apple. As noted in previous reports, the company is currently working to improve its position in the world of artificial intelligence (AI) — a field where computer systems are designed to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. The company faces pressure to prove that it can remain a leader in innovation while the global technology landscape becomes more fragmented. There are concerns about the rise of separate, incompatible AI systems around the world, often called a "splinternet," where different countries or companies use technology that cannot work together.
paragraphs.zh: 此次領導層變動發生在蘋果面臨挑戰的時刻。如先前的報導所述，該公司目前正致力於提升其在人工智慧 (AI) 領域的地位——這是一個旨在讓電腦系統執行通常需要人類智慧之任務的領域。隨著全球科技版圖變得更加破碎，蘋果面臨著必須證明自己能持續保持創新領導地位的壓力。外界對於全球各地出現各自獨立且互不相容的 AI 系統感到擔憂，這種現象常被稱為「網路分裂」，即不同國家或公司使用的技術無法相互運作。

paragraphs.en: For Ternus, the goal is to keep Apple at the top by focusing on both immediate product releases and long-term vision. He expressed his excitement about working with the team to build the future, stating that there is no other group he would rather work with. By keeping the focus on creativity and new ideas, the new CEO hopes to continue the company's long history of success.
paragraphs.zh: 對特納斯而言，目標是透過專注於即時的產品發布與長遠的願景，讓蘋果保持在頂尖地位。他表達了對與團隊共同打造未來的興奮之情，並表示沒有其他團隊是他更想共事的。透過持續聚焦於創意與新點子，這位新任執行長希望能延續公司長久以來的成功歷史。

paragraphs.en: As the September 9 event approaches, the eyes of the tech industry will be on Ternus. This event will serve as his first major public appearance as the leader of one of the world's most valuable companies. Whether the new products meet the high expectations of customers and investors remains to be seen, but the message from the new CEO is clear: Apple is ready to move forward with big plans and a commitment to creating the next generation of technology.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著九月九日的活動逼近，科技產業的目光將聚焦在特納斯身上。這場活動將是他作為全球最有價值公司之一的領導者，首次公開亮相。新產品是否能滿足消費者與投資人的高度期待仍有待觀察，但這位新任執行長的訊息很明確：蘋果已準備好帶著宏大的計畫與對創造下一代科技的承諾，持續向前邁進。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To display something proudly to others.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於日常口語，這裡指公司正式發表新產品。文中：Based on recent reports, the company is expected to show off new iPhone models.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Being planned or prepared; currently under development.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 正在籌備中、正在進行中。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上看起來與工作有關，但這裡指產品開發階段。文中：In his message to the team, he spoke about "incredible products already in the works."

keyTerms.definitionEn: It is not yet known or certain.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個固定慣用語，用來表達對未來的結果還無法下定論。文中：Whether the new products meet the high expectations of customers and investors remains to be seen, but the message from the new CEO is clear: Apple is ready to move forward with big plans and a commitment to creating the next generation of technology.

quiz.question: What is Tim Cook's role in Apple following the leadership transition?

options.A: He has retired from the company entirely.
options.B: He remains with the company as its executive chairman.
options.C: He is now serving as a consultant for the September 9 event.
options.D: He has stepped down to focus on personal projects.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段最後一句話，明確指出 Cook 將以執行董事長（executive chairman）的身分繼續支持公司。選項 A 錯誤，因為他並未完全離開；選項 C 雖然他參與了過渡期，但文章並未稱他為顧問；選項 D 則是無中生有的推測。

quiz.question: Based on the text, what can be inferred about Apple's current strategy regarding AI?

options.A: Apple is planning to abandon AI development to focus on hardware.
options.B: Apple is struggling to keep up with global competitors in the AI sector.
options.C: Apple's AI strategy is unaffected by the global trend of technological fragmentation.
options.D: Apple intends to create a closed AI system that is incompatible with all other devices.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第五段提到 Apple 正致力於改善其在 AI 領域的地位，並面臨證明其創新領導力的壓力，且全球科技環境正變得碎片化。這暗示了公司目前在該領域面臨激烈的競爭與挑戰。選項 A 與文意相反；選項 C 錯誤，因為文章明確提到碎片化是個挑戰；選項 D 過度推論，文中僅提到全球有這種趨勢，並未說 Apple 刻意要建立封閉系統。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'fragmented' mean in the context of the global technology landscape?

options.B: Growing rapidly in size and complexity.
options.C: Moving toward a single, unified standard.
options.D: Becoming more affordable for the average consumer.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在第五段中，作者提到『fragmented』是用來形容全球科技環境，隨後解釋了這涉及不同國家或公司使用無法互通的技術（即 splinternet）。這表示科技環境變得四分五裂。選項 B 與文意不符；選項 C 是『fragmented』的反義詞；選項 D 則與成本無關。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of the article?

options.A: To provide a detailed history of Tim Cook's achievements at Apple.
options.B: To speculate on the specific features of the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro.
options.C: To introduce John Ternus as the new CEO and outline the challenges and vision for Apple's future.
options.D: To explain the technical difficulties of building home robots and advanced displays.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文的核心主題在於介紹新任執行長 John Ternus 的上任，並討論他面臨的即將到來的產品發表會、公司未來的創新願景以及當前的挑戰（如 AI 與市場競爭）。選項 A 只是背景資訊；選項 B 僅是文中提到的一個細節；選項 D 是關於未來可能發展的推測，並非全文主旨。
